$jsonSchema.title: Ownership Transfers Schema - OWASP Compliant
$jsonSchema.description: A request to transfer organization ownership from one member to another (com.pml.identity.domain.model.OwnershipTransferRequest)

_class.description: Spring Data MongoDB's type hint. Written on every document by the mapping converter, so a validator with additionalProperties:false that omits it rejects every write the application makes — silently in tests, which use a template with no validator, and totally in production.

_id.description: OwnershipTransferProcess mints the id as a UUID string before the workflow starts, so a retried start finds its own transfer
